package generated

import machine "github.com/whitaker-io/machine/v4"

// Order is the payload. It is declared HERE, in the consumer, because the
// upstream flow's spliced body is compiled in this package rather than in the
// module it came from.
type Order struct {
	ID string
}

func Poll() machine.EdgeFactory[Order] { return machine.Channel[Order](0) }

func Store(f machine.Frame[Order]) Order { return f.Value() }
